edits.text: When the user provides a description of a trip but no reservation ID, call `get_reservation_details` for every reservation ID in the user's profile to identify the correct one before asking the user to select one.
edits.reason: Ensures the agent identifies the correct reservation using tool calls rather than asking the user to select from a list.

edits.text: When the user asks for information about other upcoming reservations, call `get_user_details` to retrieve all reservation IDs, and then call `get_reservation_details` for each reservation with a flight date later than the current date to confirm the details and sum the amounts.
edits.reason: Fixes hallucination and data retrieval failures when the user asks about other upcoming reservations.

edits.text: When calling `update_reservation_flights` to change a part of a trip (e.g., outbound flights) using a search result, replace all segments of that part with the segments from the search result.
edits.reason: Ensures all flight segments are correctly updated when a trip part is changed using a search result.
